The season began on 16 January and is scheduled to end on 22 December 2026.{{cite web |last=Amézquita |first=Christian |url=https://caracol.com.co/2025/11/22/liga-colombiana-2026-fecha-en-que-iniciara-y-el-sorpresivo-formato-que-tendria-por-el-mundial/ |title=Liga Colombiana 2026: fecha en que iniciará y el sorpresivo formato que tendría por el Mundial |trans-title=2026 Colombian League: Start date and the surprising format it would have due to the World Cup |publisher=[[Caracol Radio]] |language=es |date=22 November 2025 |access-date=5 December 2025}}{{cite web |url=https://dimayor.com.co/calendario-2025-2/ |title=Calendario 2026 |trans-title=2026 Calendar |publisher=[[División Mayor del Fútbol Profesional Colombiano|Dimayor]] |language=es |access-date=8 June 2026}}{{cite web |last=Yepes Izquierdo |first=Harold |url=https://www.futbolred.com/futbol-colombiano/liga-betplay/la-dimayor-mantiene-los-cuadrangulares-en-la-liga-y-recorta-la-copa-tras-el-sismo-271641 |title=La Dimayor mantiene formato de la Liga BetPlay y recorta la Copa |trans-title=Dimayor maintains the Liga BetPlay's format and shortens the Cup |publisher=Futbolred |language=es |date=19 August 2026 |access-date=19 August 2026}} Two tournaments (Apertura and Finalización) are played in the season, each one of them being an independent championship. [[Atlético Junior|Junior]] entered the season as defending champions, having won the [[2025 Liga DIMAYOR#Torneo Finalización|2025 Finalización]] tournament, and claimed their twelfth league title in the Torneo Apertura, defeating [[Atlético Nacional]] 3–1 on aggregate in the finals.{{cite web |last=Romero |first=Pablo |url=https://www.eltiempo.com/deportes/futbol-colombiano/junior-gran-bicampeon-del-futbol-colombiano-el-tiburon-le-gano-la-serie-final-a-nacional-y-celebra-su-estrella-3562937 |title=Junior, gran bicampeón del fútbol colombiano: el Tiburón le ganó la serie final a Nacional y celebra su estrella 12 |trans-title=Junior, the great two-time champion of Colombian football: the ''Shark'' won the final series against Nacional and celebrates its 12th star |publisher=[[El Tiempo (Colombia)|El Tiempo]] |language=es |date=8 June 2026 |access-date=8 June 2026}} ==Format== The competition format for the season was determined at the Extraordinary Assembly of [[División Mayor del Fútbol Profesional Colombiano|Dimayor]], held on 10 and 11 December 2025. Due to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] and the need to end the Torneo Apertura by 5 June 2026, the format proposed and eventually approved for the Torneo Apertura consisted in playing a round-robin first stage with 19 matchdays (without the extra regional derby matchday), with the top eight teams advancing to a final stage played as single-elimination playoffs instead of the semifinal group stage played in recent seasons, thus returning to the format last used in the [[2021 Liga DIMAYOR#Torneo Apertura|2021 Apertura]] tournament.{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com.co/futbol/colombia/nota/_/id/16064577/liga-betplay-2026-formato-cambios-y-que-se-debatira-en-asamblea |title=Liga BetPlay 2026: Formato, cambios y qué se debatirá en Asamblea |trans-title=2026 Liga BetPlay: Format, changes and what will be discussed at the Assembly |publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]] |language=es |date=9 December 2025 |access-date=9 December 2025}}{{cite web |url=https://www.marca.com/co/2025/12/11/693ae930268e3e64598b45a9.html |title=Revolución en la Liga BetPlay: Dimayor define dos formatos de competencia y la norma de los extranjeros en año de Mundial |trans-title=Revolution in Liga BetPlay: Dimayor sets two competition formats and the foreigner rule in World Cup year |publisher=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |language=es |date=11 December 2025 |access-date=11 December 2025}} Unlike the Apertura, the Torneo Finalización will be played under the usual format, with a round-robin first stage in which teams will play each other once (with reversed fixtures) and the top eight teams from the first stage advancing to the following phase. Instead of play-offs, the eight qualified teams will be drawn into two semi-final groups, with the two group winners advancing to play the tournament finals.{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com.co/futbol/colombia/nota/_/id/16064577/liga-betplay-dimayor-2026-cambios-formato-que-se-aprobo-asamblea |title=Liga BetPlay 2026: Dimayor aprueba cambios y nuevo formato |trans-title=2026 Liga BetPlay: Dimayor approves changes and new format |publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]] |language=es |date=11 December 2025 |access-date=11 December 2025}} ==Teams== {{Location map+ |Colombia |float=right |width=500 |caption=Locations of the 2026 Liga DIMAYOR teams |places= {{Location map~ |Colombia |lat=6.155000 |long=-75.388889 |label=
